p05.why: A function template must not have a partial specialization; Clang and GCC reject the declaration, and EDG accepts it while no call uses it (Q-0172).

p16.why: Clang and GCC accept a thread_local explicit specialization of a variable template that is not thread_local and the program returns 0; EDG rejects it (Q-0203).

p18.why: An explicit specialization of a function template must not have a default argument.
